description: This Java source file defines the class DeviceSpecificCommandConsumer, which implements the MessageConsumer interface. It manages device-specific command consumption in protocol adapters, delegating operations to an underlying DestinationCommandConsumer instance supplied via a Supplier. The class handles resource management, flow control, and credit management for device commands.

classes.name: DeviceSpecificCommandConsumer
classes.description: A final class implementing MessageConsumer that manages device-specific command consumption by delegating to a dynamically supplied DestinationCommandConsumer.

methods.name: DeviceSpecificCommandConsumer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the consumer with a supplier for the delegate and a device ID, ensuring neither is null.

methods.name: getDelegate
methods.description: Returns the current delegate consumer instance from the supplier, which may be null if not available.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the consumer by delegating to the underlying consumer's removeHandlerAndCloseConsumerIfEmpty method, or logs and fails if the delegate is unavailable.

methods.name: flow
methods.description: Delegates flow control credits to the underlying consumer if available; logs if not.

methods.name: getRemainingCredit
methods.description: Returns the remaining credit from the delegate consumer, or 0 if unavailable, with appropriate logging.
